target: tests/football-context-integration.spec.mjs > committed special results survive defense-transition and halftime overlays, then clear on Continue

invariants.workers: unset; resolved count recorded from each report.json
invariants.graceRule: Node-monotonic cap, starts after the unchanged 2500ms assertion has failed, identical for synthetic and natural instrumented failures; never changes an outcome

arms.name: block
arms.intervention: page main-thread busy-wait from arm+1300ms to arm+4400ms (page monotonic)

arms.name: stale
arms.intervention: lexical state.possessionId replaced after the answer; armed timer untouched

arms.name: cancel
arms.intervention: clearTimeout(advTimer) from an evaluate, recorded as site control-evaluate

classifierOnly: K5 no activation / not visible / exception
U missing fields, observers, multiples, missing callback

phases.unmodified: tests/football-context-integration.spec.mjs --grep <escaped target title>, no diagnostic fixture or route
phases.coverage: every run validated against one --list --grep enumeration of the canonical file

phases.spec: gen/football-context-integration.diag160.spec.mjs (full canonical file; only the target instrumented)
phases.coverage: validated against a --list enumeration of the canonical file

phases.selection: BROWSER list parsed from scripts/run-football-release.mjs, context-integration replaced by its generated full copy, one CLI, all six projects
phases.coverage: executed report validated against a --list enumeration of the unchanged canonical selection by the canonical release validate()
phases.note: diagnostic topology; not the release gate and not a historical reconstruction

stop: selfcheck failure, anchor/hash mismatch, or TOOL-DEFECT: checkpoint before anything else
control mislabel: stop; rerun only after a tool fix, new hashes and fresh review

natural execution CLIs (isolated, file, combined) run with --max-failures=1: queued cases stop after the first test failure, already-running workers may finish; unrun cases make the run incomplete (STOPPED), never PASS. Controls run without fail-fast. Classifier anomalies in passing cases are judged after the CLI exits (bounded batch limitation)

first natural anomaly (any non-PASS label, captured page exception, assertion failure, unexpected/flaky test, report error, case-coverage failure, missing diag) or unrelated failure: stop and retain; no unchanged repeat
